blocks.text: Damped oscillation mein amplitude waqt ke saath ghatta hai, lekin aik dauri bairooni quwwat, jise driving force kehte hain, laga kar use constant rakha ja sakta hai. Jab jhoolte jism par dauri driving force amal kare to oscillation forced oscillation hai aur us ki frequency driving frequency hai; chalte engine se gari ki thartharahat misal hai. Forced oscillation mein amplitude driving frequency aur jism ki qudrati frequency ke talluq par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Resonance (gunj)
blocks.text: Jab driving force ki frequency jhoolte jism ki qudrati frequency ke barabar ho to thartharahat ka amplitude bohat bara ho jata hai. Yeh resonance hai.
Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke resonance tab bhi hoti hai jab lagayi gayi frequency qudrati frequency ka poora adad guna ho: agar f1 qudrati frequency ho to f2 = 2f1, f3 = 3f1, ... fn = nf1 par.

blocks.title: Kaun se nizam guna par resonate karte hain
blocks.text: Simple pendulum ya spring par kamiyat ki sirf aik qudrati frequency hoti hai, is liye woh sirf usi frequency par chalaye jane se resonate karte hain. Khinchi taarein aur hawa ke column jaise nizamon ki qudrati frequencies ka poora silsila hota hai, f1, 2f1, 3f1 waghera, aur woh har aik par resonate kar sakte hain. Guna wali baat aise nizamon par laagu hai.

Muzahira (Fig 14.17): l1 lambai ke pendulum A aur B aur l2 lambai ke C aur D ufqi rod se latke hain, saath pendulum P jis ki lambai l1 ya l2 rakhi ja sakti hai. P ki lambai l1 ho to us ki thartharahat rod ke zariye doosron tak pohanchti hai. A aur B ko un ki apni qudrati frequency par driving force milti hai, is liye resonance se un ka amplitude barhta hai, jab ke C aur D, jin ki qudrati frequencies P se mukhtalif hain, mushkil se hilte hain. Agar P ki lambai l2 kar di jaye to C aur D resonate karte hain jab ke A aur B taqreeban rest mein rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do stands ke darmiyan aik ufqi rod se paanch pendulum latke hain: P (hara), A, C, B aur D. P, A aur B ki lambai aik jaisi l1 hai; C aur D (surkh) chhote hain, lambai l2.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Zalzale ke dauran zalzale ki lehrein imaraton ko jhula sakti hain. 8 October 2005 ko Azad Jammu aur Kashmir mein 7.6 shiddat ka zalzala aaya, jis ka markaz Muzaffarabad ke qareeb tha; 86,000 se zyada log jaan bahaq hue. (Kitab 'reactor scale' chhapti hai; zalzale ki shiddat Richter ya moment-magnitude scale par napi jati hai.)

items: Microwave oven mein khana garam karna: oven apne andar microwaves bharta hai (kitab 3-30 GHz aur taqreeban 12 cm wavelength batati hai; gharelu ovens taqreeban 2.45 GHz use karte hain). Tezi se badalta field khane mein pani ke molecules ko jhulata aur takrata hai, aur yeh tawanai hararat ban jati hai. Plastic ya sheeshe ke bartan mushkil se garam hote kyunke un mein pani nahi (kitab ki Fig 14.18 oven ki tasveer hai).

Radio tuning: analogue radio ka knob ghumane se receiver ke bijli ke circuit ki qudrati frequency badalti hai. Jab yeh kisi station ki frequency ke barabar ho to resonance hoti, us station se jazb tawanai sab se zyada hoti, aur wahi station sunai deta hai (Fig 14.19 radio ki tasveer hai).

Pul ki thartharahat: sipahiyon ko pul paar karte waqt qadam milana chhorne ka kaha jata hai. Agar woh qadam mila kar chalein to un ke qadmon ki frequency pul ki qudrati frequency ke barabar ho sakti hai, jis se pul bare amplitude se thartharaye aur gir sakta hai.

Hawai jahaz ke par: paron par aerodynamic quwwatein, turbulence aur engine ki thartharahat amal karti hain. Agar in quwwaton ki frequency paron ki qudrati frequency se mil jaye to resonance khatarnak ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Jis frequency par cheez qudrati taur par jhoolti hai use us ki resonant frequency kehte hain. Piano, violin ya guitar ka sound board thartharati taar ke saath resonate kar ke awaz ko unchi aur bharpoor banata hai. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) taqatwar radio-frequency shuaon se nuclei ko jhulata hai; jazb tawanai ka naqsha computer se behtar tasveer banata hai. Jhoole ka amplitude tab barhta hai jab use us ki qudrati frequency par dhakka diya jaye.

blocks.prompt: Pul paar karte waqt sipahiyon ko qadam milana chhorne ka kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Qadam mila kar chalna dauri quwwat lagata hai; agar is ki frequency pul ki qudrati frequency se mil jaye to resonance khatarnak had tak bara amplitude bana sakti hai.

items: Resonance: driving frequency = qudrati frequency, bohat bara amplitude.
Mufeed: microwave oven, radio tuning, saaz, MRI.
Bachna: pul par qadam mila kar chalna, jahaz ke par, zalzale mein imaratein.
